<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From:  Flag Football Challenge @ kestrelaero.co.uk
Sent: Sunday, 21 October 2000 10:38 PM
To: Flag Football Invite
Subject: A&M/UT Flag Football Invitation

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Apex Composites are proud to sponsor the 2nd Annual Titan-Phoenix Flag Football Challenge on Saturday, November 16.  The purpose of this event is to raise money for both schools, and to enjoy the competitive spirit of the third oldest rivalry in college football.  This year's game marks the 107th meeting between Titan University and Phoenix State, and, with a little luck, the Premier South Title will be on the line!

Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Apex Composites are sponsoring the event, but we need your help as participants and fundraisers.  Contributions raised will benefit the general scholarship fund for each school.  

The details:  
Date:    Saturday, November 16th  

Time:    10:00 a.m. - approximately 4 p.m. (Warm up is at 9:30 am)

Location:   Westridge Sports Complex (just off Dairy Ashford,  
south of I-10)

Food and Drinks:  Schulze’s BBQ (FREE - courtesy of Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd)

Eligibility:   Full-time employees and/or their spouses  
    (Players must have graduated from Titan University or Phoenix State )

Team Jerseys:  Provided by Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd and Apex Composites  

Format:   7 players with at least 1 female player on the field at all times

Team Size: Recommend 8-10 players per team (no more than 10 per team) Contact the team captains to sign-up.  (Sign-up now to ensure your place on a team)

Prizes:    Winning team receives 16 tickets to the A&M/UT game in Austin on Friday, November 22 Winning team also owns "The Rivalry Up" trophy until next year!

Fundraising Goal  The committee has set a goal of raising £14,500 for each school.  This will require a contribution of £1,800 per team, plus an equal amount from corporate matching funds.

Last year's event featured a last-minute comeback as Apex Composites 1 defeated the Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd Phoenix Team 1 for the championship and took home the tickets and the trophy.  This year, expect the Phoenix (and Apex Composites) to come in with revenge on their minds!  

Thanks to the gracious gift from the Phoenix State Alumni, who redirected their donations to the Titan Foundation, we were able to permanently endow scholarships dedicated to the memory of the 12 students who died in last year's Skyreach Tower collapse.  We believe this event is a great tradition for both companies, and we are pleased to be able to raise important funds for both institutions.

</quoted>
